messages.subject: Problema al descargar mxmaps
messages.body_plain:
Hola Sr. Valle,

He estado teniendo un problema al descargar su paquete. Al intentar instalarlo de github a RStudio con devtools. Me sale este mensaje de error en la consola:

* installing *source* package 'mxmaps' ...
** using staged installation
Error in file(file, if (append) "a" else "w") :
  (convertido del aviso) cannot open file '[carpeta]/00LOCK-mxmaps/00new/mxmaps/DESCRIPTION': No such file or directory
ERROR: installing package DESCRIPTION failed for package 'mxmaps'
* removing '[carpeta]/mxmaps'
Error: Failed to install 'mxmaps' from GitHub:
  (convertido del aviso) installation of package ‘[usuario]/AppData/Local/Temp/Rtmp2THLiS/file14b811e84c62/mxmaps_0.6.0.tar.gz’ had non-zero exit status

Le agradezco su atención.

[ENGLISH]

Hi Mr. Valle,

I have had a bit of a problem downloading your package from Github to RStudio with devtools. I get this error message on the console:

* installing *source* package 'mxmaps' ...
** using staged installation
Error in file(file, if (append) "a" else "w") :
  (convertido del aviso) cannot open file 'C:/Users/Martmn/Documents/R/win-library/3.6/00LOCK-mxmaps/00new/mxmaps/DESCRIPTION': No such file or directory
ERROR: installing package DESCRIPTION failed for package 'mxmaps'
* removing 'C:/Users/Martín/Documents/R/win-library/3.6/mxmaps'
Error: Failed to install 'mxmaps' from GitHub:
  (convertido del aviso) installation of package ‘C:/Users/MARTN~1/AppData/Local/Temp/Rtmp2THLiS/file14b811e84c62/mxmaps_0.6.0.tar.gz’ had non-zero exit status

Thank you very much for your attention.

messages.subject: Re: Problema al descargar mxmaps
messages.body_plain:
Creo que el problema es que tu nombre de usuario tiene un acento en la "í". Puedes intentar instalar el paquete a otro directorio (a la mejor necesitas ser administrador)

.libPaths("C:/Program Files/R/R-3.6/library") #Cambiar al directorio de R en tu sistema
devtools::install_github("diegovalle/mxmaps")
